options.reason: PAM50 is a five-level categorical intrinsic-subtype label (LumA 499, LumB 197, Basal 171, Her2 78, Normal 36) and the remaining 17,852 numeric columns are homogeneous gene-expression measurements, so the evident aim is supervised multiclass subtype prediction from expression with PAM50 as the sole target; sample_id is a row key and must be dropped, and no expression column is a recoding of the label. Macro-F1 is requested by the brief but the workflow rails leave primary_metric null so the workflow metric governs, with per-class precision-recall and a confusion matrix reported alongside.
options.title: multiclass
